note: Every sha256 and byteSize here was read from the live Hugging Face LFS metadata or computed from an actual download on the date above, not copied from documentation. Verification is by SHA-256 on the downloaded bytes, so a wrong value here fails loudly rather than installing a corrupt model.

assets.detail: Fastest. The default: speed matters more than transcript polish for short commands.
More accurate, roughly twice the work. Worth it if tiny.en mishears names.
The default. Picks the right tool reliably, including 24-hour conversions like "half past six in the evening".
assets.source: ggml-org, the llama.cpp organisation's own GGUF conversion of Google's QAT checkpoint (google/gemma-3-1b-it-qat), at Q4_0, ungated. Replaces the vinimuchulski mirror of google/gemma-3-1b-it-qat-q4_0-gguf, whose file does not tokenise <start_of_turn> as a control token, so the model never saw its own turn markers. Digest and size read from the Hugging Face LFS metadata and matched against a downloaded copy on 2026-10-26.

assets.detail: Noticeably better at unusual phrasing, at roughly three times the size and latency. Only worth it on a phone with RAM to spare.
assets.source: ggml-org's GGUF conversion of google/gemma-3-4b-it-qat at Q4_0, ungated. Replaces the vinimuchulski mirror, which had the same <start_of_turn> tokenisation defect as the 1B. The text model only: the repository's mmproj file is for images, which nothing here uses. Digest and size read from the Hugging Face LFS metadata and matched against a downloaded copy on 2026-10-26.

assets.detail: The speaking voice. 22 kHz, one speaker.
assets.source: sherpa-onnx tts-models tag. That tag is an asset host rather than a version, so the URL stays valid across sherpa-onnx releases.

assets.detail: Reads text out of pixels when a screen has none to give: photos, video, games.
assets.source: tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast on GitHub, main branch. Digest and size recorded from the downloaded file on 2026-09-02.

assets.detail: Closes the microphone sooner after you stop talking where there is a fan, a vent or birdsong. Optional: without it the microphone just waits longer in noisy places.
assets.source: snakers4/silero-vad on GitHub, tag v5.1.2, the v5 model: only this version, because the voice check feeds it 576-sample windows and a model with another window size would end the process. Digest and size computed from a download on 2026-10-27.
